title: Match classification in the last round of four-team round-robin tournaments
abstract: arXiv:2605.25610v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Classification of matches played in the last rounds of sports competitions is a well-established tool for evaluating tournament designs. Our paper offers the first comparison of deterministic and probabilistic match classification models by analysing the most prominent example of four-team round-robin competitions, the group stage of the FIFA World Cup. We show that both models are highly relevant in practice: all (four) deterministic and (six) probabilistic match types occurred in the 2014 and 2018 FIFA World Cups, respectively. The probabilistic model, which accounts for the relative benefits of attacking and defending, provides a deeper insight; for instance, the competitive matches from the deterministic approach can be of any of the six probabilistic types. translated_title: 四队单循环赛制最后一轮比赛的分类
translated_abstract: 对体育比赛最后一轮所进行比赛的分类是评估赛制设计的一种成熟工具。本文通过分析四队单循环赛制最突出的例子——世界杯小组赛，首次对确定性和概率性比赛分类模型进行了比较。我们证明了这两种模型在实践中都具有高度相关性：2014年和2018年世界杯分别出现了全部四种确定性比赛类型和全部六种概率性比赛类型。考虑进攻与防守相对收益的概率性模型能够提供更深入的洞察；例如，确定性方法下的竞争性比赛可以是六种概率性类型中的任何一种。因此，我们使用概率性模型来分解2026年世界杯引入的三项改革的影响：参赛队伍扩展至48支、修改后的晋级赛制……
tldr: 本文首次比较了确定性与概率性两种比赛分类模型，以世界杯小组赛为例证明两类模型均具实践相关性，并利用洞察更深的概率性模型分析了2026年世界杯三项改革的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper offers the first comparison of deterministic and probabilistic match classification models using FIFA World Cup group stages, showing both are highly relevant in practice, and employs the deeper probabilistic model to decompose the impact of three reforms in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
